Test provider routing by sending requests to OpenAI and Anthropic

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.literllm.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var requestJson = "{\"max_tokens\":5,\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Say hi.\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"openai/gpt-4o-mini\"}";
        var request = JsonUtil.fromJson(requestJson, ChatCompletionRequest.class);
        var apiKey = System.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY");
        if (apiKey == null || apiKey.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalStateException("OPENAI_API_KEY must be set");
        try (var client = LiterLlm.createClient(apiKey, null, null, null, null)) {
        var result = client.chat(request);
        System.out.println(result);
        }
    }
}
```
